stem: Which graph shows a line with an x-intercept of -5?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with line passing through (-5, 0) sloping upward right

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with line passing through (-1, 0) sloping upward right

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with line passing through (-1, 0) sloping downward right

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with line passing through (-5, 0) sloping downward right

visual_elements: Four coordinate plane graphs labeled A, B, C, D each with a single line graphed.
notes: Options labeled A, B, C, D correspond to different lines on coordinate grids. X-intercept is where the line crosses the x-axis at y=0.
